arxiv-1608-00173.creator: Fabiano M. Andrade, Augusto R. Chumbes, Cleverson Filgueiras, Edilberto O. Silva
arxiv-1608-00173.description: Abstract In this work, we study the scattering of a spinless charged particle constrained to move on a curved surface in the presence of the Aharonov-Bohm potential. We begin with the equations of motion for the surface and transverse dynamics previously obtained in the literature (Ferrari G. and Cuoghi G., Phys. Rev. Lett.

arxiv-2011-15022.title: Boundary behaviour of the Span metric and its higher-order curvatures Thanks: The author was supported by the postdoctoral fellowship of Harish-Chandra Research Institute, Allahabad.
arxiv-2011-15022.creator: Amar Deep Sarkar
arxiv-2011-15022.description: Abstract . In this note, we use scaling principle to study the boundary behaviour of the span metric and its higher-order curvatures on finitely connected Jordan planar domains. A localization of this metric near boundary points of finitely connected Jordan domains is also obtained.

arxiv-2109-01630.title: Do Minimal Parity Solutions to the Strong C ​ P CP Problem Work?
arxiv-2109-01630.creator: Jordy de Vries, Patrick Draper, Hiren H. Patel
arxiv-2109-01630.description: Abstract One class of solutions to the strong C ​ P CP problem relies on generalized parity symmetries. A minimal model of this type, constructed by Babu and Mohapatra and based on a softly broken parity symmetry, has the remarkable property that effective QCD vacuum angle θ ¯ \bar{\theta} vanishes up to one-loop order.

arxiv-2111-08317.title: Inspection of 19 globular cluster candidates in the Galactic bulge with the VVV survey
arxiv-2111-08317.creator: E. R. Garro, D. Minniti, M. Gómez, J. Alonso-García, V. Ripepi, J. G. Fernández-Trincado, F. Vivanco Cádiz
arxiv-2111-08317.description: Abstract Context. The census of the globular clusters (GCs) in the Milky Way (MW) is still a work in progress. It has been possible to discover many new star clusters both in the Galactic disk and bulge thanks to the advent of new deep surveys.

arxiv-2203-07668.title: Measuring the tau polarization at ILC
arxiv-2203-07668.creator: Keita Yumino, Daniel Jeans
arxiv-2203-07668.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Keita Yumino, Daniel Jeans. Measurement of the tau lepton polarization in e − ​ e + → τ − ​ τ + e^{-}e^{+}\to\tau^{-}\tau^{+} is an important electro-weak measurement at ILC and other future electron-positron colliders.

arxiv-2208-02040.title: Reducibility and nonlinear stability for a quasi-periodically forced NLS
arxiv-2208-02040.creator: E. Haus B. Langella, A. Maspero, M. Procesi
arxiv-2208-02040.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by E. Haus B. Langella, A. Maspero, M. Procesi. Motivated by the problem of long time stability vs. instability of KAM tori of the Nonlinear cubic Schrödinger equation (NLS) on the two dimensional torus 𝕋 2 := ( ℝ / 2 ​ π ​ ℤ ) 2 {\mathbb{T}}^{2}:=({\mathbb{R}}/2\pi{\mathbb{Z}})^{2} , we consider a quasi-periodically forced NLS equation on 𝕋 2 {\mathbb{T}}^{2} arising from the linearization of the NLS at a KAM torus. We prove a reducibility result as well as long time stability of the origin.

arxiv-2311-16378.title: Bayesian Spectral Graph Denoising with Smoothness Prior
arxiv-2311-16378.creator: Sam Leone 1 † {\dagger} , Xingzhi Sun 2 † {\dagger} , Michael Perlmutter 3 and Smita Krishnaswamy 1,2,4,5,6,7,8
arxiv-2311-16378.description: Abstract Here we consider the problem of denoising features associated to complex data, modeled as signals on a graph, via a smoothness prior. This is motivated in part by settings such as single-cell RNA where the data is very high-dimensional, but its structure can be captured via an affinity graph. This allows us to utilize ideas from graph signal processing.

arxiv-2402-01643.title: L-TUNING: Synchronized Label Tuning for Prompt and Prefix in LLMs
arxiv-2402-01643.creator: Md Kowsher, Md. Shohanur Islam Sobuj, Asif Mahmud, Nusrat Jahan Prottasha, Prakash Bhat
arxiv-2402-01643.description: Abstract Efficiently fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for specific tasks presents a considerable challenge in natural language processing. Traditional methods, like prompt or prefix tuning, typically rely on arbitrary tokens for training, leading to prolonged training times and generalized token use across various class labels.

arxiv-2501-16151.title: Breaking the degeneracy in stellar spectral classification from single wide-band images
arxiv-2501-16151.creator: Ezequiel Centofanti, Samuel Farrens, Jean-Luc Starck, Tobias Liaudat, Alex Szapiro, Jennifer Pollack
arxiv-2501-16151.description: Abstract The spectral energy distribution (SED) of observed stars in wide-field images is crucial for chromatic point spread function (PSF) modelling methods, which use unresolved stars as integrated spectral samples of the PSF across the field of view. This is particularly important for weak gravitational lensing studies, where precise PSF modelling is essential to get accurate shear measurements.

arxiv-2503-02255.title: AxBERT: An Interpretable Chinese Spelling Correction Method Driven by Associative Knowledge Network
arxiv-2503-02255.creator: Fanyu Wang ID, Student Member, IEEE, Hangyu Zhu, Zhenping Xie ID Member, IEEE
arxiv-2503-02255.description: Abstract Deep learning has shown promising performance on various machine learning tasks. Nevertheless, the uninterpretability of deep learning models severely restricts the usage domains that require feature explanations, such as text correction. Therefore, a novel interpretable deep learning model (named AxBERT) is proposed for Chinese spelling correction by aligning with an associative knowledge network (AKN).

pmc-10602255.creator: Hui Li

pmc-11475939.title: Radiation Therapy in the Management of Head and Neck Mucosal Melanoma
pmc-11475939.creator: Omar Azem, Omar Nabulsi, Michael Jelinek, Nikhil Joshi, Kevin Camphausen, René-Jean Bensadoun
pmc-11475939.description: Simple SummaryMucosal melanoma is a rare and aggressive form of melanoma that primarily occurs in the mucosal tissues of the head and neck. Due to its rarity and complexity, treatment strategies for this type of cancer are challenging, with surgical removal often followed by radiation therapy.

pmc-12305022.title: MicroRNA-320а as a novel biomarker at preclinical stage of necrotizing enterocolitis in term neonates with congenital heart defects
pmc-12305022.creator: Ekaterina K Zaikova, Aleksandra V Kaplina, Natalia A Petrova, Tatiana M Pervunina, Alexey S Golovkin, Anna A Kostareva, Olga V Kalinina
pmc-12305022.description: BACKGROUNDNecrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) remains a prominent gastrointestinal emergency among infants, particularly term infants with congenital heart defects (CHD) being at high risk. The molecular processes that contribute to NEC have yet to be completely understood. The high mortality rates necessitate an active search for noninvasive biomarkers that can aid in the preclinical diagnosis and prognosis of NEC.

pmc-12557751.title: Impact of loneliness on cancer mortality: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12557751.creator: Samantha Cheng, Joshua Yi, Keiran Pace, Anna Santiago, Carlton Johnny, John-Jose Nunez, Jane Jomy, Srinivas Raman
pmc-12557751.description: ObjectiveLoneliness and social isolation can have profound emotional and psychological impact on patients with cancer. Previous studies suggest loneliness may adversely impact cancer prognosis and survival. Potential mechanisms include a variety of biological, psychological and social factors, from impaired ability to access treatment to immune dysregulation. However, its impact is not clearly defined.

pmc-12658539.title: Exploring experiences of mental health challenges in under-represented young people (aged 16–24 years) in England: a narrative inquiry protocol
pmc-12658539.creator: Rebecca Syed Sheriff, Jason Arday, Rohit Shankar, Roisin Mooney, Louise Chandler, Helen Adams, Lili Z Nagy, Roger Farrell, Daisy Fancourt, Scott Weich, Catherine Henderson, Shaima Hassan, Joe Langley, Kamaldeep Bhui
pmc-12658539.description: IntroductionThree-quarters of mental health problems start before the age of 25. However, young people are the least likely to receive mental healthcare. Some young people (such as those from ethnic minorities) are even less likely to receive mental healthcare than others. Long-term impacts of mental health problems include poorer physical health, relationships, education and employment.

pmc-12669614.title: AMP-activated protein kinase–Caspase 6 axis regulation alleviates the combined apoptotic damage caused by deoxynivalenol and fumonisin B1 in mammary glands
pmc-12669614.creator: Liguang Cao, Guojin Li, Kai Liu, Wenrui Gao, Yifei Dong, Zifeng Yang, Jianchun Luo, Lin Lei, Xiliang Du, Yuxiang Song, Xinwei Li, Wenwen Gao, Guowen Liu
pmc-12669614.description: Deoxynivalenol (DON) and fumonisin B1 (FB1) are prevalent mycotoxins commonly found together in dairy cow feed, posing significant risks to cow health and food safety. This study investigates combined toxic effects of DON and FB1 on bovine mammary epithelial cells (BMECs), and role of AMPK-Caspase 6 axis in mycotoxin-induced apoptosis in BMECs and mouse model.

pmc-12702236.title: Disentangling the biopsychosocial effects of gender-affirming hormone therapy on social health: A protocol for a multi-arm prospective cohort study (AFFIRM Relationships)
pmc-12702236.creator: Margot WL Morssinkhof, Nessa Millet, Giulia T Zoppolat, Sigsten K Stieglitz, Baudewijntje PC Kreukels, David Matthew Doyle
pmc-12702236.description: IntroductionGender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT) is associated with improvements in gender congruence and changes in psychosocial functioning, yet its effects on social health are not yet known. Social health, i.e., someone having adequate quantity and quality of relationships to meet their needs for meaningful connection, is a key determinant of quality of life.

pmc-13146648.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1056 HOME-BASED SUPERVISED CARDIORESPIRATORY INTERVAL TRAINING DECREASES POST-STROKE FATIGUE AND IMPROVES CARDIORESPIRATORY FITNESS—A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL
pmc-13146648.creator: Anna Bråndal, Maria Svedjebrant, Ylva Nilsagård, Per Wester
pmc-13146648.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsPost-stroke fatigue (PSF) is prevalent, impacting nearly half of stroke survivors and limiting recovery and daily life. Currently, no proven treatment exists. Reduced cardiorespiratory fitness may contribute to PSF, making aerobic exercise a potential therapeutic option.MethodsWe performed a two-center, randomized, open-label trial with blinded outcome assessment to investigate a home-based, supervised cardiorespiratory interval training program (HS-CITP) in individuals with PSF (Swedish Fatigue Assessment Scale [S-FAS] ≥28) within 1–7 months post-stroke.

pmc-13150957.title: Tenofovir Alafenamide in the Treatment of Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in the High‐Replicative Low‐Inflammatory Phase: A 48‐Week Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13150957.creator: Qiumin Luo, Ruixuan Xu, Yeqiong Zhang, Wenxiong Xu, Xiangyong Li, Jing Lai, Jianguo Li, Xingrong Zheng, Hong Deng, Lubiao Chen, Xiang Zhu, Chan Xie, Liang Peng
pmc-13150957.description: Antiviral treatment for chronic HBV infection in the “high‐replicative low‐inflammatory” phase has not been widely recommended. This study aimed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of antiviral therapy in this patient population and analyze peripheral immunological characteristics in relation to treatment response.

pmc-13342398.title: E-cigarette Aerosol Containing Nicotine Increases Aortic Stiffness in Young Mice
pmc-13342398.creator: Pireyatharsheny Mulorz, Joscha Mulorz, Agnesa Mazrekaj, Hsiang-Han Liu, Wiebke Ibing, Joshua M Spin, Lasse Bach Steffensen, Hans C Beck, Uwe Raaz, Kensuke Toyama, Hubert Schelzig, Philip S Tsao, Markus U Wagenhäuser
pmc-13342398.description: E-cigarettes (E-cigs) are widely used especially among young people, but the effects on vascular stiffening and remodeling are poorly understood. This study evaluates the effects of short-term e-cig exposure on young vs. adult mice and the effects of e-cig derived chemicals present in plasma and urine of exposed animals on cultured endothelial cells (EC) and vascular smooth muscle cells (SMC).

pmc-13583746.title: Deep learning-based CT model for non-invasive prediction of tertiary lymphoid structures in pancreatic cancer: a multicenter study with prospective validation in an immunochemotherapy cohort
pmc-13583746.creator: Haopeng Yu, Xiaoying Li, Xuan Cheng, Yan Deng, Yuqi Wang, Yu Li, Bingjie Liu, Zixing Huang, Dan Cao
pmc-13583746.description: BackgroundPancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the most lethal malignancies. Tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) have emerged as key components of the tumor immune microenvironment, associated with improved survival and enhanced immunotherapy response. However, non-invasive detection of TLS remains a significant clinical challenge.

pmc-13619568.title: Partial coherence control delivers skyrmionic topological resilience and transitions
pmc-13619568.creator: Yonglei Liu, Shiqi Chen, Zhenyu Guo, Kaiqi Zhu, Yahong Chen, Yangjian Cai, Yijie Shen, Fei Wang
pmc-13619568.description: Optical skyrmions have recently unlocked topological quasiparticle textures of light, rising in prominence for next-generation ultra-robust information processing. However, to date, their study has been mainly confined to coherent laser fields. Here we extend skyrmions to more general light sources of partially coherent, stochastic optical fields.

pmc-13656877.title: Navigating Asparaginase Treatment for Patients With Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia: US Consensus Panel Recommendations on the Role of Multidisciplinary Care
pmc-13656877.creator: Amir Ali, Grace Elsey, Kayla Fulginiti, Zanette Kanani‐Bradley, Holly R. Kubaney, Sandra Kurtin, Theresa Nguyen, Jennifer Turchina, Charlotte B. Wagner
pmc-13656877.description: Asparaginase is a critical treatment component for patients with acute lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoblastic lymphoma (ALL/LBL). However, the successful delivery of asparaginase‐based therapy remains challenging across care settings due to its complex administration, distinct toxicity profile, prolonged treatment duration, and the need for coordinated multidisciplinary care.
